page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs using the AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at 2.55 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a 2.0 GB per core ratio. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core and single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng tests. The processor supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX, AES, and SHA_NI, which contribute to strong performance in cryptographic operations and database tasks. Memory performance is mixed; while cached small-block read bandwidth is strong, uncached large-block read and write bandwidths fall into the average category. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and ray tracing workloads also demonstrate strong execution speeds.

The dedicated core allocation provides predictable performance-per-resource efficiency for sustained compute workloads, though the lack of bundled local storage requires external storage provisioning. The instance exhibits average performance in single-threaded tasks, software compilation, and text processing. For machine learning, it achieves strong token generation speeds with small LLM models but drops to average performance with medium-sized models. Given the compute-heavy profile and 16 Gbps network baseline, this instance is suited for compute-intensive workloads, multi-threaded data processing, database operations, and moderate-scale web serving.
